fixes.change: permission.routed is update-only in the projection: a routing update racing past its own permission.replied can no longer re-insert a settled request as an unremovable phantom gate. Regression test added (stale routed after replied must not resurrect; routed for unknown session must not create).

historySettled latch gates the 500ms older-page poll until hydration + snap-to-bottom complete; prevents up to 22 sequential page loads (2.52MB) on large sessions from a race the heavy sessions always lost.

Derivation memo keyed on append-only signature (count + max(sequence), one indexed query). Repeat calls drop from ~119ms flat O(N) re-derive to a cache hit; bounded at 64 sessions with insertion-order eviction.

refreshGovernance fingerprints authoritative snapshots (proofHash + event count + tail id) and skips the deep Solid reconcile of up-to-500 merged events when unchanged; applied-map entry cleared on session.deleted.
